name: demon-academy
description: Demon Academy - 2D anime pixel-art action RPG (Phaser 3 + Capacitor)

scripts.android:setup: npx cap add android && npx @capacitor/assets generate --android && node android-config/apply-android-config.js
scripts.android:debug: npx cap sync android && node android-config/apply-android-config.js && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
